concept.title: Run History
concept.shortdesc: The Run History page shows the results of all sync runs across every sync in your organization, allowing you to monitor publishing activity and investigate errors.

conbody.p: Click Run History in the navigation menu to open the Run History page. Each row in the table represents one sync run and shows:

ul.li: A status badge indicating the outcome of the run
The name of the sync that produced the run
The date and time the run started, displayed in your local timezone
The number of articles changed during the run, when available

section.title: Run statuses
section.p: Each run is assigned one of the following statuses:

dlentry.dd: The run has been queued and is waiting to start.
The run is actively processing content. Do not trigger another run for the same sync while a run is in this state.
The run finished successfully. All changed content was processed and published to the target system.
The run encountered a problem that prevented it from completing. An error message is recorded with the run. Check your sync configuration and credentials, then trigger the run again.
An unexpected error occurred during the run. An error message is recorded with the run. If the problem persists after retrying, contact your system administrator.

section.title: Changed count
section.p: The changed count reflects the number of articles that were created or updated in the target system during the run. A count of zero on a completed run is normal when no content has changed in Heretto Deploy since the previous run.
section.note: A full resync does not advance the change cursor, so the changed count during a full resync reflects the total number of articles processed, not the number of newly changed articles.
